reviews.t: Not the Original
reviews.x: NOT THE ORIGINAL SCENT. I used to exclusively wear candies from 1999 until it was discontinued,I still have 2 original bottles that I save for special occasions. When I saw that it was being produced I was overjoyed & immediately ordered a bottle. While it smells similar to the orginal,it's a ALOT weaker,and not as potent. Don't get me wrong,I actually like the scent,but it's more of a nod to the old with an update. It takes 5 sprays to get the desired scent,and it wears off fast.

reviews.t: Not the Candies for men I thought
reviews.x: Smells good, but is somewhat misleading I was under the impression it was a different cologne. I should have paid more attention to the one other review.

reviews.t: Don't be fooled - this is NOT the Candie's For Men you're looking for
reviews.x: I used to wear Candie's all the time. I still have a little left in an old bottle. I was excited to finally see Candie's back on the market so I didn't hesitate to order a bottle. I just got it today. One spray is all it took to know this is nothing close to the original Candie's For Men smell. I was immediately sorry I wasted time and money ordering this. You'll probably never be able to sample this in a store because - for sure - nobody would buy it. Horizon Beauty Group clearly saw the high-p

reviews.t: Doesn't smell like original but definitely worth buyin
reviews.x: My favorite cologne is candies and when I saw that they brought it back I was excited. I bought it after reading the reviews where some said it smelt like it and others said it didn't at all. I had some extra money in my account so I only paid $5.15 for my bottle. I just received it today and unfortunately it DOESN'T smell like the original. I was disappointed. But to my surprise it smells REALLY GOOD! I will recommend that you buy it. And I uploaded a photo to show that I have an original bottl

reviews.t: Nothing like the OG
reviews.x: Candies was one of my all time favorites and I hated that it was discontinued. So you can imagine my excitement when i found out it was back on the market. I was so excited in fact that i blind purchased 3 bottles off the bat cause i thought “who knows how long its back for!?”  Well….unfortunately this relaunch does not deserve the name. This new juice is a completely different recipe. Does it smell good? I mean…..ehh…very generic fresh scent like one you’d get from an Axe or Bod body spray. It

reviews.t: not quite
reviews.x: Smells good but nothing like the original

reviews.t: A welcoming update to the original
reviews.x: I read the reviews before smelling this for myself, but I was pleasantly surprised. It’s not the original, but this is a really pleasant clean, refreshing, attractive scent that won’t be offensive to a lot of people. I already got a compliment from my wife, so that’s a win right off the bat. The performance seems a little better than the original. Dry drown leaves a sensual smell of lotus, sandalwood, and amber. Overall I’m pleased with this and this will be added to my rotation.

reviews.t: Candies colone
reviews.x: I loved candies 20 something years ago, definitely is not the same number one. So I purchased one to try it and second it's all water because the scent comes out strong but only lasts 10 to 15 minutes then disappears. Buyer beware total rip off....

reviews.t: Not the original scent but good
reviews.x: I knew this was not the original scent but decided to try it and I like the smell.. definitely not the original scent from 20 years ago but nice scent. If your looking for the original Dua brand candy is almost identical to original,also I company called scent matchers also makes a replica that smells just like the original. Dua is about $50 for 1oz scent matchers is about $75 for the 3.4oz. so there you go if your looking for original otherwise this has a fresh updated scent that is pretty nice

reviews.t: A very close to original smell
reviews.x: Definitely not the original but damn close to it. The longevity is what makes it not as close to the original. Back in the day, 2-3 sprays and you were set for the whole day. With the remake, you will need to spray a few times a day for it to last lol. Other then that great buy for $20.

reviews.t: It's back!
reviews.x: Wore this exclusively for 10 years, was heartbroken when they stopped making it. Needless to say I'm incredibly satisfied and happy it's back. I know there will be many more bought. Yes it is the exact same as it was years ago when they still made it. 20/10, will buy again and again.

reviews.t: This doesn't smell like the candies cologne from years ago.
reviews.x: It's a nice size bottle and it smells good but it's not the old school candies cologne that I was expecting.

reviews.t: Not the Candies Cologne I used a few years ago -- this is water in a fancy bottle
reviews.x: I was excited to see this cologne again; until I purchased a bottle. This is basically water in a fancy bottle. The faint scent only last for 5 seconds. Whoever thought tarnishing the name of Liz claiborne  was a good idea.  Please, if you plan to bring back Candies for Men restore the original formula. This current product is dishonesty and crookery.

reviews.t: Not the original formula but still smells great
reviews.x: When I met my husband he was wearing candies for men. I had been searching for it for years when I found this in Amazon. It arrived and looked the same, but it is not the same as the original. Something is just a bit different. It still smells nice on my husband and  we would buy it again.

reviews.t: Smells good.
reviews.x: Not exactly like the original. Missing the strong lavender/cedar wood like smell. Smells good enough to wear everyday though. Have had compliments. Not as strong as the original either. Need to spray more..

reviews.t: Smells like the older version per sil
reviews.x: My daughter had me to order this for her husband who loved this scent when younger and he said it smells just like he remembers. And was very happy with it.

reviews.t: Love this smell
reviews.x: Smells pretty much like the old one. I love the scent!  Would be nice if it lasted a little longer but overall a great smell for a good price

reviews.t: Updated, different yet the same, but great scent!
reviews.x: You can tell it is a new version of a classic scent.  I love it just the same.  Change is good.  I recommend

reviews.t: Not even close to the original
reviews.x: Was hoping this was close to the original scent but it really isn’t. Should have went with something else.

reviews.t: Straight to the garbage
reviews.x: I can't believe this got such high reviews. It smells nothing like the original.

reviews.t: NOT the original
reviews.x: It is absolutely NOT the original Candies smell, but, it's not bad!!!

reviews.t: strong performance
reviews.x: I bought this as a blind buy, as there were no reviews on this fragrance. I used to really like the original Candies, from back in the day. I was so upset when it was discontinued. That said, my nostalgia got the best of me when I saw this on Amazon. I don’t recall what the original Candies smelled like, so its hard to say how close this is to the OG formulation, but this one smells really sweet. My initial response to it was “aqua net hairspray with citrus magic”. It is very ‘orangey’, and the

reviews.t: IDK what this is
reviews.x: Loved the ‘Candies’ from +20 years ago. This isn’t it. I read the reviews, and thought I’d take a chance despite all the reviews that said ‘this isn’t Candies’, and I lost. Such a bummer. Not even remotely the same. Doesn’t smell BAD, but it’s just not Candies. I think Liz Claiborne sold the name Candies but not the recipe. I’ll use it on linens, around the house as a freshener. I’m glad it was a cheap lesson and not a costly one. I was so looking forward to smelling Candies again 😂 I’m so bumme

reviews.t: Was Impressed after reading reviews.
reviews.x: It does actually smell similar to the original candies. If you want something that smells identical get DUA #candy. It will save you from buying a $300 partially used bottle off ebay. This new scent is really nice I like it alot. I loved original candies BTW. Glad I went with my gut and ordered it, because I almost didn't because the reviews.

reviews.t: Not the original but give it a chance.
reviews.x: I barely remember what the original Candie's fragrance smells like but I do know this isn't exactly the same. That said, this is a very tasty fresh scent on the same level. The watermelon from the original seems to have been at least partially replaced with a darker mandarin orange. Definitely worth the 20 bux.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the scent is not the same as the original Candies cologne.
Many reviewers still find the scent pleasant or good despite it differing from the original.
Several reviewers complain about poor longevity, saying the scent fades quickly or requires frequent re-spraying.
A few reviewers say it smells very close to or exactly like the original.
Some reviewers mention receiving compliments on the scent.
